title: The Coconut That Knew Where to Land

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A coconut drops neatly into a villager's empty basket: stand still and wait for another, or tell everyone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is walking under the palms with an empty basket on (subject.his/her) hip when, with a soft thump, a coconut drops out of a tree and lands neatly in the basket. Not on (subject.his/her) head. Not on the ground. In the basket. (subject.He/she) stops. (subject.He/she) looks up. The tree looks innocent.

choices.label: Stand Still and Wait for Another

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Nobody believes (subject.him/her). Even so, the next day half the village is strolling about under the palms with baskets held out hopefully. Nothing falls. Then, late in the afternoon, a coconut drops gently into (friend)'s lap while (friend.he/she) is sitting resting against a trunk. Now (friend) won't stop talking about it either.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) stands perfectly still under the tree with the basket held out. It's a long wait. A bird lands on the rim of the basket and looks at (subject.him/her). A second coconut falls, a long way off, nowhere near. By sunset (subject) has one coconut and a very stiff arm, and is still certain the tree did it on purpose.
